name: Zhurong
def: China's first Mars rover, which explored southern Utopia Planitia for a year and found evidence of water altered soils and buried shorelines.
body: Zhurong rode the Tianwen-1 orbiter to Mars and landed in Utopia Planitia in May 2021, making China the second country to operate a rover on the Martian surface. Four foldable solar panels powered a six wheel active suspension that could lift a wheel or crab sideways, with ground penetrating radar, a laser induced breakdown spectrometer and a magnetometer. It drove 1,921 metres in about a year and reported hydrated minerals in young dune deposits and radar layering read as ancient coastal sediments, then entered hibernation in May 2022 and never responded again.
facts: Made China the second nation to drive a rover on Mars
Travelled 1,921 metres before hibernating in May 2022
Radar data supported the case for ancient shoreline deposits
specs: Six wheel active suspension able to crab sideways and lift wheels
Four foldable solar panels with a phase change heat storage system
Navigation and topography cameras, multispectral camera, ground penetrating radar, laser induced breakdown spectrometer, magnetometer, weather station
Ground planned drives with onboard hazard detection
